## What our customers say

> "Our old setup dropped logs whenever traffic spiked, which is exactly when we needed them. We moved 40 services over in a weekend. Since then we've had one gap, eleven seconds, during a region failover — and it was in the docs as a known limit."
>
> **Priya Raghunathan**, Staff SRE, Northwind Freight

> "I don't care about dashboards. I care that at 3am I can type a service name and a five-minute window and get an answer before I'm awake enough to be annoyed. That's the whole product for me."
>
> **Tom Alvey**, Platform Lead, Kestrel Health

> "We were spending $18k a month shipping logs we never read. The retention tiers cut that to about $6k, and honestly the archive search is fast enough that I stopped noticing which tier a query hit."
>
> **Dani Okonkwo**, Director of Engineering, Beacon Payments

> "Onboarding took a day and a half, most of which was me arguing with our own Terraform. Support answered a parsing question on a Sunday. I've since recommended it to two other teams."
>
> **Marcus Feld**, Backend Engineer, Halyard Labs
